description: We are second-year ECE engineering students from VCET, Erode, working on the "Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts" challenge. Our focus is edge AI and explainable AI: an offline, on-board health monitor that detects anomalies in astronaut vitals and explains why each alert fired. We are looking for teammates skilled in web development, data visualization, graphic design, data analysis, and communications to help build the dashboard and pitch.
